item.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Wednesday
item.description: Indian markets plunged on Monday as the Sensex fell nearly 900 points and the Nifty dropped below 22,900, wiping out nearly Rs 5 lakh crore in market value. Private bank selling, weak global cues and earnings uncertainty weighed on sentiment.

item.title: Market Trading Guide: Federal Bank among 4 stock recommendations for Wednesday
item.description: Indian equities weakened amid negative global cues and selling in private banks and IT stocks, pushing the Nifty below 23,000. Choice Equity Broking’s Sachin Gupta recommends four stocks—Federal Bank, ACME Solar, Dr Reddy’s Laboratories and Union Bank—for potential upside.

item.title: Jio IPO opens tomorrow: How can investors maximise allotment chances under Rs 2,500 crore RIL shareholders quota
item.description: The much-anticipated Reliance Jio Platforms IPO is launching for public subscription starting October 21, 2023. Shareholders of Reliance Industries can benefit from a Rs 2,500 crore reservation aimed at maximizing their investment opportunities. Those eligible are encouraged to apply in both the shareholder and retail categories. Shares are priced between Rs 1,065 and Rs 1,119, with allotments set for October 26 and listings on October 28.

item.title: WhatsApp stock tips: Nithin Kamath warns of more pump-and-dump schemes as ED freezes accounts worth Rs 200 crore
item.description: In a post on X, formerly Twitter, Kamath said such schemes remain a concern even in 2026, calling them one of the silliest ways for investors to lose money. He also warned that these cases could become more frequent as the market cycle advances, pointing to a rise in alleged pump-and-dump schemes operating through WhatsApp groups and influencers promoting stocks and initial public offerings (IPOs).

item.title: Mukul Agrawal portfolio: Ace investor adds 7 new equity stocks in Q2. Do you own any?
item.description: 7 stocks he likely added to his secondary market portfolio during the second quarter of FY27. With shareholding disclosures still being released, further changes to his portfolio cannot be ruled out.

item.title: From ₹228 a GB to ₹7.5: How Mukesh Ambani’s Jio rewired India’s internet and is now seeking a ₹10 lakh crore valuation
item.description: The company is now asking investors to value it not merely as a telecom operator, but as a broader technology platform spanning 5G, fixed broadband, cloud, entertainment, enterprise services and artificial intelligence.

item.title: Stock Market Holiday 2026: Is stock market closed today for Dussehra? Check remaining holidays for the year
item.description: A total of 16 stock market holidays have been scheduled for 2026, out of which twelve have already passed. After the Dussehra holiday, trading will remain suspended on three more occasions over the remaining two months of the year.

item.title: HFCL Q2 net profit jumps 448% to Rs 394 crore
item.description: Net profit surged 448.14% year-on-year to ₹394.22 crore from ₹71.92 crore a year ago, while revenue increased 143.62% to ₹2,541.79 crore from ₹1,043.34 crore. Sequentially, profit increased 60.49% from the previous month, and revenue rose 32.73%.

item.title: Steelmakers may outperform non-ferrous peers in Q2 as higher volumes support earnings
item.description: Non-ferrous companies are expected to see a sequential decline in earnings, with revenue and Ebitda expected to fall 2% and 13%, respectively. The decline in average LME aluminium prices is likely to weigh on their profitability.

item.title: UltraTech Cement Q2 net profit up 21% in September quarter
item.description: A near 14% year-on-year growth in grey cement volumes to 35.94 mt in the domestic market, though, helped UltraTech clock in a near 19% year-on-year growth in consolidated sales to ₹23,295 crore. This also helped the profit before interest, depreciation and tax rise more than 17% to ₹3,832 crore. Consolidated profit for the quarter rose 21% on-year to ₹1,501 crore.

item.title: ED freezes trading accounts in scam tied to social media
item.description: Last week, the ED's Mumbai Zone conducted searches at 29 premises across six cities-Mumbai, Nashik, Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Surat and Bhavnagar-under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA). The case relates to R M Drip and Sprinklers Systems and R&B Denims, the agency said. According to the ED, the two companies issued more than 35 million shares and convertible warrants through preferential allotments between April 2023 and March 2024. A substantial portion of the funds allegedly came from a small network of connected individuals, firms and lenders, it said.

item.title: NSE, BSE to hold Diwali Muhurat trading on November 8
item.description: According to circulars issued by the NSE, the special trading session will begin at 2:20 pm on Sunday. Continuous trading in stocks covered by the closing auction session (CAS) will end at 3:15 pm, followed by the closing auction, while trading in other stocks will continue until 3:30 pm. Equity futures and options trading will run from 2:20 pm to 3:40 pm.

item.title: Union Bank Q2 net profit up 30% as margins improve
item.description: Total advances in the September quarter increased 19% year-on-year to ₹11.6 lakh crore, led by a 17% growth in domestic advances, which was supported by a 24% increase in corporate advances to ₹5.2 lakh crore. The bank has a corporate loan pipeline of ₹1 lakh crore.

item.title: Brokerages back ICICI Bank on strong Q2 earnings, see HDFC Bank recovery ahead
item.description: Brokerages remain optimistic about ICICI Bank's strong earnings and asset quality after the recent quarter. However, HDFC Bank's profit growth was modest, and margins are under pressure, leading to a more cautious outlook. Despite this, both banks have attractive valuations and positive earnings recovery prospects. On Monday, both stocks experienced declines, along with broader market indices. Analysts highlight potential upsides for both banks based on target prices.

item.title: Banking stocks, high oil prices drag Indian markets lower
item.description: Across Asia, markets were mixed, with South Korea rebounding 1.8% from last week's losses amid simmering concerns over excessive investments in artificial intelligence (AI). Taiwan fell 0.6%, while Indonesia tumbled 3.6% following a warning from index provider MSCI that it would downgrade the country from the emerging market basket.

item.title: SBI data breach claim: Hackers allegedly access 3.75 lakh accounts
item.description: "The threat actor describes this as the first disclosure of the dataset, Cyberpulse56 said, adding that the authenticity, origin and extent of the alleged exposure are inverified. If legitimate, the data could facilitate identity theft, financial fraud, targeted phishing and fraudulent loan applications, the group said.

item.title: RBI injects Rs 1 lakh crore as liquidity tightens before festive season
item.description: On Monday, the RBI announced a Rs 1-lakh-crore variable rate repo (VRR) auction for the first time since late July after the weighted average call rate (WACR) at 5.67% on Monday, or 17 basis points higher than the repo rate of 5.50%. The central bank will conduct another VRR for Rs 50,000 crore on Wednesday.

item.title: Yes Bank's evaluating capital actions to back growth plans
item.description: "The manner and the timing of reinstatement of the bonds as well as payment of the coupon is also under assessment," Niranjan Banodkar, CFO, Yes Bank told analysts over a call after the earnings.

item.title: Central Bank of India reports technical glitch in RTGS outward system
item.description: Central Bank said that no customer suffered any financial loss on account of the incident. The lender has not attributed the disruption to a cyberattack and said the root cause is still under examination.

item.title: Ireda net profit grows to Rs 554 cr in Sep qtr
item.description: Ireda has announced a net profit of Rs 554 crore for the September quarter of FY27, reflecting a robust financial performance. Revenue from operations increased by 14%, totaling Rs 2,345 crore. Additionally, loan disbursements surged by 31%, reaching Rs 10,579 crore. This quarter also marked an 11% rise in net worth, showcasing Ireda's strength in renewable energy financing and management of asset quality.

item.title: Bajaj Finance Q2 consolidated net profit rises 29% to Rs 6,367 crore
item.description: Bajaj Finance expects AUM to grow 26-27% in FY27 as it accelerates customer acquisition and loan disbursements. The lender plans to book 60-62 million new loans and add 18-20 million customers during the year. Consolidated AUM grew 26% to Rs 5.85 lakh crore in the September quarter, aided by broad-based loan growth. The gold-loan portfolio more than doubled to Rs 24,195 crore, although short-tenor schemes caused a transitional increase in Stage 2 assets. Management does not expect this movement to affect credit costs. Lower funding costs, improving asset quality and a strong liquidity buffer should support growth.

item.title: Waaree Renewable Technologies Q2 Results: Net profit falls 29% to Rs 81 crore
item.description: Waaree Renewable Technologies experienced a notable 29 percent drop in net profit for the quarter ending September. Their consolidated profit stood at Rs 81.48 crore, a decrease from Rs 116.36 crore year-on-year. While expenses surged, revenues rose to Rs 1,057.84 crore. The company boasts an unexecuted order book over Rs 5,500 crore and a robust bidding pipeline, striving for long-term value through efficiencies and scaling.

item.title: Piramal Finance Q2 net profit soars 67% to Rs 545 crore
item.description: Piramal Finance’s assets under management grew 24% to Rs 1.13 lakh crore, led by a 30% rise in retail AUM. Net interest income increased 35%, while its net interest margin expanded 35 basis points to 6.5%.

item.title: PC Jeweller among 8 stocks that hit 52-week high and rallied up to 42% in a month
item.description: The Sensex plunged 876 points to close at 73,852, even as eight BSE 1000 stocks touched fresh 52-week highs. PC Jeweller led monthly gains at 42%, followed by Sky Gold and Diamonds at 31%, highlighting divergent stock performance.

item.title: Bajaj Finance Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 29% YoY to Rs 6,367 crore, NII up 24%
item.description: Bajaj Finance Q2 Results: Bajaj Finance reported a 29% year-on-year increase in net profit to Rs 6,367 crore in the September quarter, compared with Rs 4,948 crore a year earlier. Net interest income rose 24% to Rs 13,335 crore from Rs 10,785 crore in the year-ago quarter. Net total income increased 23% to Rs 15,974 crore from Rs 12,982 crore.

item.title: Hindustan Zinc Q2 Results: Net profit skyrockets 142% YoY to Rs 6,412 crore, revenue soars 77%
item.description: Hindustan Zinc reported a 142% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 6,412 crore, while revenue surged 76.5% to Rs 15,093 crore. EBITDA doubled to Rs 9,285 crore, with margins expanding to 62% on higher prices and production.

item.title: Muhurat Trading 2026: BSE, NSE announce date and timings of special session. Check details
item.description: BSE and NSE has announced the schedule for Diwali Muhurat Trading 2026, set for Sunday, November 8, on the occasion of Laxmi Pujan. The special session will run from 2:20 pm to 3:30 pm, with separate timings for pre-open trading, block deals, IPOs, call auctions and closing procedures.

item.title: Cupid, Sterlite Tech among stocks top 10 equity PMS portfolios hold as Nifty, Sensex plunge up to 13% in 2026
item.description: Despite a sharp market downturn in 2026, all 10 top-performing equity PMS strategies delivered positive returns in September, ranging from 3.55% to 5.67%. Amaltas Asset Management’s Keystone Fund led the rankings, while Cupid and Sterlite Technologies featured among the prominent holdings across multiple portfolio management strategies.

item.title: FIIs raise stakes in 8 smallcap stocks in Q2; shares surge over 200% in FY27 so far
item.description: Eight smallcap stocks have surged over 200% in FY27 so far as foreign institutional investors increased their shareholdings in the September 2026 quarter. Kabra Extrusiontechnik led the gains at 343%, followed by Modison at 333%, according to ACE Equity data.

item.title: UltraTech Cement Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 21% YoY to Rs 1,494 crore; revenue up 19%
item.description: UltraTech Cement Q2 Results: The cement maker reported a 21% year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 1,494 crore in Q2 FY27, while revenue grew 19% to Rs 23,295 crore. However, profit fell 43% sequentially amid monsoon-related disruptions and the West Asia crisis, with margins also declining from the previous quarter.

item.title: Jio’s mega IPO breaks all records with Rs 2.5 lakh crore anchor demand: BlackRock, GIC, LIC participate
item.description: Jio Platforms is making waves with its IPO, drawing in around Rs 2.5 lakh crore from institutional investors, reflecting remarkable enthusiasm in the market. With backing from renowned global asset managers and sovereign wealth funds, this Rs 30,200 crore offering launches on October 21, featuring a price band of Rs 1,065 to Rs 1,119 per share. The company aims to use most proceeds to clear existing debts, enhancing financial stability.

item.title: HFCL Q2 Results: Profit zooms 448% YoY to Rs 394 crore; stock hits 5% upper circuit
item.description: HFCL reported a 448% year-on-year jump in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 394 crore, compared with Rs 71.92 crore a year ago. Revenue surged 144% to Rs 2,542 crore, while EBITDA rose 224% to Rs 658 crore. EBITDA margin expanded 640 basis points to 25.89%. The optical fibre and AI beneficiary’s stock hit the 5% upper circuit at Rs 268.70 on the BSE and has gained nearly 300% so far this year.

item.title: HDFC Bank vs ICICI Bank: One has the growth, the other has the valuation edge. Which stock to buy?
item.description: ICICI Bank has outperformed HDFC Bank in 2026, supported by stronger deposits, loan growth and profitability. While ICICI commands a valuation premium, HDFC’s 28% stock decline has created a potential recovery opportunity. Brokerages see scope for HDFC’s margins to improve, but narrowing the growth and funding gap remains key.

item.title: How to trade Tech Mahindra shares after 22% rally in 4 days? Technical expert weighs in
item.description: Tech Mahindra shares fell 2.1% after a sharp post-results rally, as investors booked profits. Brokerages remain divided, with Nuvama projecting 25% earnings growth over two years, while Nomura maintains a Neutral rating amid a focus on future growth and margins.

item.title: PSU bank stocks soar up to 8%, but HDFC, Axis and other private lenders fall up to 5% after Q2 results. Why the sharp divide?
item.description: PSU bank stocks surged up to 8% on Monday, led by Punjab National Bank after its Q2FY27 earnings beat estimates. In contrast, private lenders such as Axis Bank and HDFC Bank fell up to 5% despite reporting profit growth. The Nifty PSU Bank index gained over 2%, while its private-sector counterpart declined.

item.title: PNB shares jump 8% after Q2 results beat estimates; Jefferies, Motilal Oswal, others raise target prices
item.description: Punjab National Bank shares rose sharply on Monday after the lender reported a 13% year-on-year rise in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 5,532 crore. Stronger net interest income and improving asset quality prompted bullish brokerage calls, with Jefferies, Motilal Oswal and JM Financial setting target prices of Rs 140 apiece.

item.title: PC Jeweller shares soar 26% in just two sessions. Here’s what’s triggering the sharp surge
item.description: PC Jeweller shares rallied 26% in two sessions after Cupid promoter Aditya Kumar Halwasiya bought 5.10 crore shares worth Rs 73.60 crore. The jewellery maker recently repaid its dues to 14 consortium banks, achieving debt-free status ahead of schedule.

item.title: Easy exits hurting Indian stocks: Nirmala Sitharaman explains why equities are underperforming
item.description: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman says easy liquidity is allowing investors to exit Indian equities as the Nifty and Sensex struggle to deliver positive returns. Foreign investors have pulled out nearly $63.6 billion since October 2024, erasing nine years of inflows, amid rising US yields, a stronger dollar and AI-driven investment shifts.

item.title: Kross shares rally 16% after Q2 profit jumps 143% YoY; stock hits 52-week high
item.description: Kross shares surged following strong Q2 FY27 results, with revenue rising 80% and net profit climbing 143% year-on-year. EBITDA more than doubled, while margins improved. Robust commercial vehicle demand, capacity expansion and operational efficiencies supported growth, alongside increased institutional shareholding and the stock reaching a fresh 52-week high.

item.title: Stock Market Holiday 2026: Are NSE, BSE closed on October 20 for Dussehra? Check remaining holidays for the year
item.description: The Indian stock market will remain closed on October 20, 2026, for Dussehra. Earlier this month, the market observed a holiday for Gandhi Jayanti on October 2. Following Dussehra, trading will also be suspended for Diwali on November 10 and Guru Nanak Jayanti on November 24. The last market holiday of the year will take place on December 25 for Christmas.

item.title: Ixigo shares rally 13% after travel platform reports all-time high profit
item.description: Ixigo shares jumped after the travel platform reported a record Q2 profit of Rs 63.42 crore, partly boosted by the sale of its stake in Freshbus. Gross transaction value rose 22% year-on-year to Rs 5,304.47 crore, while revenue grew 13% to Rs 320.96 crore and contribution margin increased 14% to Rs 124.86 crore.

item.title: Sugar stocks Balrampur Chini, Bajaj Sugar, others crash up to 7% as centre stops diversion to ethanol
item.description: Sugar stocks dropped in early trading following the government's directive to cease sugar diversion for ethanol production. The decision impacts major sugar companies like Balrampur Chini Mills and Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar, which experienced a decline between 2% and 7%. This directive aims to enhance domestic sugar availability amidst rising prices. The government's action follows concerns about potential production shortfalls due to insufficient rainfall.

item.title: Tech picks: Indian Hotels among 5 stocks to buy for healthy returns in short term
item.description: The Indian stock market is rebounding, powered by robust investments in IT sectors and encouraging earnings reports. Analysts highlight five stocks as prime buying opportunities, projecting solid short-term gains. Indian Hotels, Lemon Tree, and Supreme Industries make the list. While technical indicators show strong demand, investors are cautioned about looming global inflation and geopolitical tensions.

item.title: Stock Market Down: Bulls lose ground! Sensex sinks nearly 900 points, Nifty ends below 22,900; 5 key triggers behind Rs 5 lakh crore selloff
item.description: Why is Market Down Today: The Indian stock market took a hit on Monday after a considerable rise the previous week. Both Sensex and Nifty struggled, with Axis Bank and HDFC Bank suffering significant losses. However, firms like SBI and UltraTech Cement managed to post gains. The PSU Bank index rose, providing a stark contrast to the declining private banking sector.

item.title: Yes Bank shares rise as Q2 profit beats estimates, but AT1 bond verdict hit pegged at Rs 5,217 crore. What lies ahead?
item.description: Yes Bank shares rose after falling 17% over two sessions, following a 65% year-on-year jump in Q2 net profit to Rs 1,080 crore. However, the lender cautioned that the reported earnings exclude the potential impact of the Supreme Court’s AT1 bond ruling.

item.title: HDFC Bank shares fall 2% after Q2 results. What are Jefferies, Motilal Oswal analysts saying?
item.description: HDFC Bank shares fell up to 2% after the lender reported a 4.6% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 19,510 crore. Jefferies, Motilal Oswal, Systematix and Emkay retained positive ratings, citing margin recovery potential and leadership transition.

item.title: Urban Company shares slide 7% as Q2 net loss triples YoY on InstaHelp burn. Should you buy, sell or hold?
item.description: Urban Company shares fell sharply on Monday after its Q2FY27 net loss more than tripled YoY to Rs 182 crore, driven by investments in InstaHelp. Revenue rose 41% year-on-year to Rs 537 crore. Motilal Oswal maintained a Neutral rating but cut its target price to Rs 165, citing profitability concerns and balanced risk-reward.

item.title: ICICI Bank share price target after Q2 results: What are Jefferies, other analysts saying?
item.description: ICICI Bank Share Price: ICICI Bank shares rose after Q2FY27 net profit increased 20.1% year-on-year to Rs 14,843 crore, while net interest income grew 17.7% to Rs 25,339 crore. Jefferies maintained its ‘Buy’ rating with a target price of Rs 1,750, implying 25% upside, citing improving margins and expectations of 16% core profit CAGR over FY26-29.

item.title: 11 years, zero net FII flow: How a $64 billion outflow erased 9 years of equity buying
item.description: Foreign institutional investors have dramatically pulled back from Indian equities, reversing nearly nine years of consistent investment. A massive $63.6 billion in outflows occurred, particularly pronounced in 2026. Industries suffering the most include financial services, automobiles, and oil and gas. Although domestic investors have somewhat mitigated the foreign sell-off, the prospects for renewed foreign investments appear grim, with rising bond yields and energy costs dampening interest.

item.title: Axis Bank shares fall over 4% despite 38% YoY jump in Q2 net profit. Why brokerages are revising target prices
item.description: Axis Bank reported a 38% year-on-year rise in standalone net profit to Rs 7,003 crore in Q2 FY27, while net interest income rose 12%. Jefferies retained its Buy rating, while Centrum Broking and Dolat Capital lowered their target prices.
